title: Teamwork - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Teamwork in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Teamwork is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Gains scale with the number of living allies.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: Gains scale with the number of living allies.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
